hypothesis: At fixed architecture and training length (4 layers, d_model=64, 3000 steps, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], best-of-3 controls), the final force margin falls with log(steps_per_orbit) between N=64 (0.21-0.26) and N=256 (0.03-0.04). At N=128 (seeds 20-21, matched to the existing N=16/64/256 arms) it is intermediate. The accel_step control R2 also falls between the N=64 (0.77-0.79) and N=256 (0.65-0.67) values.
expected_if_true: Final force margin is in [0.08, 0.19] in both seeds, accel_step control R2 is in [0.66, 0.78] in both seeds, and headroom-normalized accel_step margin is in [0.62, 0.77].
expected_if_false: Final force margin is >= 0.20 in both seeds (collapse happens between N=128 and N=256, a sharp threshold) or <= 0.07 in both seeds (collapse already complete by N=128). Seeds that split across bands count as inconclusive.
